headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Coolify documentation spans 480 pages with 100% crawl coverage and strong retrieval readiness (86.77 overall score). Critical gaps: 0% example reliability estimate, 1.04% last-updated coverage, and 69.27% of pages flagged with stale risk. API reference coverage is solid at 85.47% across 20 detected pages. Evidence coverage stands at 59.2% (222 of 375 key claims backed), and 75% actionability coverage indicates reasonable user guidance.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

priority_actions.title: Add last-updated timestamps to all 475 pages currently missing them (raise from 1.04% to 100%)
priority_actions.why_this_first: Freshness signals directly reduce stale risk (69.27%), build user trust, and improve SEO with minimal engineering lift.

priority_actions.title: Backfill evidence for the 153 unsupported claims (40.8% gap) prioritizing API and integration pages
priority_actions.why_this_first: Evidence gaps erode credibility in technical evaluation; targeting API docs (20 pages) maximizes trust impact per page edited.

priority_actions.title: Audit and validate code examples across all 480 pages to establish baseline reliability above 0%
priority_actions.why_this_first: Zero example reliability blocks onboarding velocity and drives support tickets; fixing top 20 high-traffic pages yields immediate user wins.

strengths: Complete crawl coverage (480/480 pages, 100%) with no trap URLs or scope issues
Strong retrieval readiness band (86.77 score) with 98.75% answerability and 98.96% citationability
API reference coverage at 85.47% with 20 pages detected, no detection issues flagged
risks: 0% example reliability estimate across 480 pages suggests no validated code samples or detection failure
69.27% stale risk rate indicates majority of content lacks freshness signals, undermining trust
Only 1.04% last-updated coverage (5 pages) leaves users unable to assess currency of 475 pages
40.8% of key claims (153 of 375) lack evidence, risking credibility and support escalations
limitations: External audit cannot verify runtime correctness of code examples or test actual execution in user environments; 0% reliability estimate may reflect detection limits rather than true sample quality.
Stale risk and freshness metrics rely on visible timestamps and heuristics; pages may be current but lack machine-readable signals, inflating perceived staleness.
Evidence and actionability scoring depends on content structure patterns; non-standard formatting may cause under-detection of valid claims or CTAs.
automation_first: Deploy CI-based code example testing to prevent 0% reliability from recurring: run linters and smoke tests on all detected code blocks (estimated 200+ across 480 pages), catching breaks before publish and reducing support load from broken samples.

Automate last-updated timestamp injection via build pipeline to maintain 100% freshness coverage (currently 1.04%, 475 pages missing): eliminates manual toil, cuts stale risk from 69.27%, and boosts SEO with zero ongoing effort.

Implement weekly broken link scanner with Slack alerts for the 480-page corpus (currently 1 broken link, 0 unverified): prevents link rot at scale, protects user trust, and avoids manual audits as docs grow beyond 500 pages.
